# Zork I story file

`zork1.zip` is the compiled Zork I story file — **Release 119 / serial number
880429**, a Z-machine v3 game.

It is a byte-identical copy of `COMPILED/zork1.z3` from
<https://github.com/historicalsource/zork1>:

    md5  1d4606016ea58ee038da53d994392323
    sha1 c4f162274869b5433e4b9dfa7ee770fc3b789525

In November 2025, Microsoft's Open Source Programs Office, Team Xbox and
Activision released Zork I, II and III — source and compiled builds — under the
MIT License. `LICENSE` in this directory is that grant, verbatim. See
[the announcement][ann].

[ann]: https://opensource.microsoft.com/blog/2025/11/20/preserving-code-that-shaped-generations-zork-i-ii-and-iii-go-open-source/

Note that Release 119 is a final-development build that Infocom never sold
commercially, so it may not have gone through release testing — expect the odd
obscure bug that retail Zork I does not have.

The grant covers code and game data. It does **not** grant rights to any
trademarks or brands, which remain with their respective owners.
